objections: minGroup=10 merges nothing: the smallest fare product has a 0.345% share (~69 of 20000 taps), so value_reduced survives unmerged and still reveals a disability-discount card, which is the stated trap.

No listed utility task (bike duration, bike zone demand, bike distance, card-type mix from cards.card_type) needs fare product, so the Art. 9-adjacent disclosure buys no listed utility; tokenising would also leave the reduced category recognisable by frequency.
